maddeler.e:
أحتكر (form VIII)
# أَحْتَكِرُ (ʔaḥtakiru) /ʔaħ.ta.ki.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
# أُحْتَكَرُ (ʔuḥtakaru) /ʔuħ.ta.ka.ru/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
# أَحْتَكِرَ (ʔaḥtakira) /ʔaħ.ta.ki.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
# أُحْتَكَرَ (ʔuḥtakara) /ʔuħ.ta.ka
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
